svg.title: The Lumora bird, perched on a branch, reading a note
svg.desc: Thank-you card front. The master mark, both paths verbatim, turned 8 degrees as a whole, with the bird's eye under the crest. Added drawing in Ink: legs and gripping feet (three toes forward, one back), a tapered branch with a fork, a stub and three leaves, and an open note in Sheet white tucked into the twig at eye level, lines of words only. The branch runs off the left edge on purpose: the card runs it into the bleed.
